About Event

​Welcome to SearchHack: Build the Next Layer of AI Search

​AI has changed how people search, but most of what’s out there is still a search box with an LLM attached. We think the interesting work is a layer deeper, and we want to spend a day building it with you.

​SearchHack is a one-day hackathon for engineers, researchers, and founders working on how information gets found, retrieved, routed, and remembered by AI systems.

​Judges

​Investment Director, Micron Ventures

​Investment Lead, Llama Ventures

​Investor, Foothill Ventures

​Investment Lead, Sixty Degree Capital

​Innovation Manager, Plug and Play

​VP, Sky9 Capital

​Prizes

​1st place: iPhone 18 Pro + $1500 Telem AI credits + 30,000 Tavily credits

​2nd place: Apple Watch Series 12 + $800 Telem AI credits + 20,000 Tavily credits

​3rd place: AirPods 5 + $300 Telem AI credits + 10,000 Tavily credits

​The problem

​AI systems have too much information and not enough sense of what to do with it. Context gets fragmented, retrieval is expensive, personalization is weak, memory is limited, and routing across different sources is mostly guesswork. Keyword search doesn’t solve this, and neither does putting a chatbot on top of it.

​What to build

​Anything that makes AI search meaningfully better. Some directions we’d love to see:

​Retrieval that goes beyond keyword matching

​Long-context and memory systems

​Routing queries to the right engine, database, or tool

​Agents that plan, search, verify, and synthesize across sources

​Faster, cheaper retrieval with fewer wasted tokens

​Knowledge graphs and connecting scattered information

​Search that understands a user’s context and history

​Search across images, video, audio, and code

​New interfaces for working with information

​You don’t have to stick to this list. If you have a better idea, build that.

​Schedule

​10:00 – Check-in, team formation

​10:30 – Kickoff, rules, judging criteria

​11:00 – Building starts

​1:00 – Lunch

​4:15 – Submissions due, demo prep

​4:30 – Judging

​5:30 – Final presentations

​6:15 – Winners announced

​7:00 – Wrap

​Projects will be judged on innovation, technical execution, search intelligence, and impact.

​Come build something!

All Agents, Now in Sync.
Join us for the BAND Dark Factory Buildathon, powered by HackerSquad , at AWS Builder Loft in San Francisco on Friday, November 13, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM PST .
Spend the day building an AI Software Factory, where AI coding agents work together to produce working software from specifications using BAND Desktop .

BAND provides infrastructure for collaboration between AI agents and humans. Its shared interaction layer lets agents communicate, delegate, and coordinate while keeping their own tools, models, and memory. BAND also offers tools for developers to coordinate coding agents in a shared workspace.

​RIENDLY EACH ONE TEACH ONE MONDAY EVENINGS WITH WOMEN AND NON-BINARY FOLKS. IT’S FREE FORM! TEACH A CLASS IF YOU’D LIKE!

​​

​​Since this is mostly screen-free and face to face, this frees up the meeting for everyone to work on whatever they want and participate at will!

​​​​​​​​​​The SudoRoom has hardware of all types: analog audio, soldering tools, a lasercutter, and more! So this isn’t just a software workshop.

​​EACH ONE TEACH ONE

​​Interesting in leading a class? Giving a talk? We have had talks around artificial intelligence, algorithms, the rust programming language, and linux at our women and non-binary hack night.

​​Just sign up and offer to teach one!

​​Don’t worry if you don’t have tons of experience on your topic. Sometimes the best teachers are beginners teaching beginners.

​​​​​​​​​HARDWARE HACKING

​​​​​​​​​​Poke around our wiki to see all the cool toys we have!

​​​​​​​​​We have a bunch of tools on our wiki such as the Big Red Laser Cutter https://sudoroom.org/wiki/Big_red_laser_cutter

​​​​​​​​​Yes, we have 3D printers! https://sudoroom.org/wiki/Printing

​​​​​​​​​Browse older projects and get them jump-started again like the Hack Pack https://sudoroom.org/wiki/Hackpack

​​

​​STARTING OFF WITH A WIKIPEDIA ENTRY AND WHITEBOARDING FROM THERE WITH JADE!

​​

​​ABOUT WOMEN AND NON-BINARY HACK NIGHT

​​The Sudo Room, creative community and hackerspace at Omni Commons, invites all Women/NB people for “WNB Coding/Hacking Night”: bring your computer and a coding project and have fun! We can help each other if you have coding/hacking-related questions/bugs or just keep company while hacking! If you are a beginner, we can help you get started (even if you’ve never coded before!). And if you’re an intermediate programmer looking for a challenge, we can help you find problems to work on.

​​No computer? No problem: we can provide one for the night. Coders/Hackers of all abilities are welcome! All coding languages are welcome! Bringing a WNB friend is highly recommended. Join in person if you’re in Oakland or online anywhere else in the world!

​​The idea is also to be a safe space for WNB in the tech world, besides promoting empowerment, also to provide emotional support for those facing challenges in a work environment, tech job search or anything else related.

​○ General Repair: Fix it Clinic’s weekly Oakland residency: bring your broken, non-functioning things – electronic gadgets, appliances, computers, toys, sewing machines, fabric items, etc.– for assessment, disassembly, and possible repair. In addition to regular machines our Sewing Lab features heavy-duty industrial sewing machines and sergers.
